description: Footstep sounds by place on map6_s02 (Lakeside Pier and Lighthouse). After the character's own footsteps table, every rule of "places" whose conditions all hold replaces the step sound, in file order, so the last match wins. Conditions (each optional): "surface" / "not_surface" (surface names of gamedata/world/surfaces.json), "room" (the map's room index), "x" / "z" ([min, max] of the player's position in metres, inclusive, null = open), "y_above" (metres; the player's y is greater, y grows downwards). They test the player's position for every character's step, as the original did. "sound" is a sound name of gamedata/sounds; "name" identifies the rule (on_footstep scripts see it as e.place, and a mod's maps/map6_s02/footsteps.json replaces or adds rules by name). Here the lighthouse has its own step: in room 20 only below y 0 (y grows downwards), in room 21 on every surface but concrete.
